record.question: Sheik Hasina was sworn in on January 12, 2014 for Prime Minister of Bangladesh for the
record.explanation: Answer C: Third time. Sheikh Hasina took office on 12 January 2014 for her third term as Prime Minister, following terms beginning in 1996 and 2009. Bangladesh's embassy biography explicitly records the third-term date. Historical/source note: Historical term count at the stated January 2014 date; the archived biography's present-tense title is not a current-office claim. Reference: https://bangladootankara.org.tr/banglades-hakkinda/saygideger-basbakan/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
